name: Sabbatic Year
overview: The Sabbatic Year, also called the Year of Release, is a divinely appointed time when the land is to rest and lie fallow, allowing the poor to gather food and the land to recover, as seen in Exodus 23:10-11. It also includes the release of Israelite bondservants after six years of service, as commanded in Exodus 21:2. These ordinances emphasize God's provision and justice within the covenant community, underscoring both physical rest for the land and social restoration among the people.
